dialogues.speaker: Yazykov
dialogues.text: Is this where I'm supposed to be standing?

dialogues.speaker: Yazykov
dialogues.text: Me? I'm being interviewed and photographed by that reporter... They call it an "interview," but honestly, it's pure torture.

dialogues.speaker: Yazykov
dialogues.text: He's digging for every single detail of the day we caught that octopus... The color of the sky, the humidity of the air...

dialogues.speaker: Yazykov
dialogues.text: He even asked about the wrinkles on my fingers from the water! As if that's going to help anyone haul in a fishing net...

dialogues.speaker: Yazykov
dialogues.text: Honestly, I'm praying someone would come by and put a stop to this... *sigh*
